name: Homepage & Navigation
description: Verifies the homepage hero section renders, navigation links work, language toggle switches to Arabic, and gallery teaser section loads.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the homepage at the root URL
Verify the hero section is visible with a large heading and navigation links in the top bar
Click the 'Bridal' link in the top navigation
Verify the Bridal collection page loads showing a product grid with product cards
Click the browser back button to return to the homepage
Click the language toggle button in the navigation bar
Verify the page text switches to Arabic with right-to-left layout and Arabic text visible
Click the language toggle again to switch back to English
Verify the page returns to English with left-to-right layout
Scroll down to the gallery teaser section on the homepage
Verify the gallery section is visible showing thumbnail images and a 'View Full Gallery' link
